decisions.reason: The area elastic sports flooring builds on the firm's established wood-surface and sports-floor know-how, so its own R&D can interpret results and refine it, although it sits outside the trend-led residential focus.
The mobile arena floor draws on existing sports-floor expertise and serves a project-based niche where the firm can learn from installations, but it overlaps with Product C.
This second mobile arena system duplicates Product B, making it the more likely candidate for consolidation, yet it still rests on knowledge the firm already holds.
The chevron parquet is close to the core premium flooring offer, was featured on the home page and matches the firm's style-oriented direction, so the firm can readily assimilate market feedback.
The squash court finish applies the firm's surface-finishing know-how to a small niche where it can still learn and improve, though its limited volume makes it vulnerable.
The oak skirting is a low-effort accessory that complements the sports floor systems and uses existing oak processing knowledge.
